title: Columbus Global Shapers archival status — depth 7
summary: The launch effort remains evidenced, but current activation, official hub identifier, curator/member roster, and any pause/dissolution record remain unresolved.

alternatives: The Columbus launch effort never completed activation.
A Columbus Hub operated briefly and later paused or dissolved.
A Columbus Hub existed under an identifier or archival surface not found in the bounded search.

provenance.method: Primary-source recursive OSINT with bounded current-directory and archival-name search

data.question: Who attempted the Columbus Global Shapers launch, did it receive an official hub identifier, and was it paused, dissolved, or never activated?
data.method: Re-reviewed the current Cleveland Hub project page, current Global Shapers public discovery surfaces, and bounded exact-name searches for a Columbus Hub, curator, roster, or official identifier.
findings: The Cleveland Hub still publicly describes Columbus Hub as a launch it was supporting in Columbus, Ohio.
Current Global Shapers surfaces expose a large active hub/member network, but the bounded exact-name review did not recover a current Columbus Hub page, official hub identifier, curator, or roster.
No reviewed source established that the Columbus launch formally activated, paused, dissolved, or was rejected.
limitations: Search non-discovery is not proof that the hub never existed or was formally dissolved.
No archived Global Shapers platform page with a Columbus hub identifier was recovered in this pass.
